title: The Jar of Rainwater
story: Teacher Adeyemi asked the class to measure rain for one week. Priya put a clear jar in the school garden each morning. She marked the water level with a pen before lunch. On Monday the jar held only a thin line. On Wednesday a storm filled it much higher. Priya wrote the results in a notebook and drew a simple chart. She noticed the jar was lower on Thursday. A classmate named Ben said birds might have drunk from it. Priya covered the jar with a loose net that still let rain in. On Friday the level matched the puddles on the path.
